proposed_workflow.title: Extract example.com heading and first paragraph

blocks.label: extract_heading_and_paragraph
blocks.prompt: The Example Domain page is open, showing its introductory paragraph, and the block holds heading, the page's heading text, and first_paragraph, the text of the first paragraph as it appears on the page. Opens https://example.com, waits for the first paragraph to be visible, reads the first h1 if one exists (otherwise the page title) and the first paragraph's text.

proposed_workflow._copilot_yaml:
title: Extract example.com heading and first paragraph
workflow_definition:
  parameters: []
  blocks:
  - block_type: code
    label: extract_heading_and_paragraph
    prompt: The Example Domain page is open, showing its introductory paragraph, and
      the block holds heading, the page's heading text, and first_paragraph, the text
      of the first paragraph as it appears on the page. Opens https://example.com,
      waits for the first paragraph to be visible, reads the first h1 if one exists
      (otherwise the page title) and the first paragraph's text.
    code: "await page.goto(\"https://example.com\")\nawait page.locator(\"p\").first.wait_for(state=\"\
      visible\")\nfirst_paragraph = (await page.locator(\"p\").first.inner_text()).strip()\n\
      h1 = page.locator(\"h1\")\nif await h1.count() > 0:\n    heading = (await h1.first.inner_text()).strip()\n\
      else:\n    heading = (await page.title()).strip()\nreturn {\"heading\": heading,\
      \ \"first_paragraph\": first_paragraph}"
    data_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        heading:
          type: string
        first_paragraph:
          type: string
      required:
      - heading
      - first_paragraph
    steps:
    - description: Open https://example.com
      action_type: goto_url
      line_start: 1
      line_end: 1
    - description: Extract first paragraph
      action_type: extract
      line_start: 3
      line_end: 3
    - description: Extract heading
      action_type: extract
      line_start: 6
      line_end: 6
